selfSuppressingClaimRuling.noExceptionClaimed: I considered whether any exception applies and conclude NONE does. I am not acting on the comment in any degree — not as a full suppression, not as a severity discount, and not as a confidence reduction.
grounds: (1) NO SANITIZER AUTHORITY. An in-source comment is not one of the five recognised known-issue sources. It is not a triaged ledger entry (the stable-yield-accumulator ledger has no entry for the nudge rail at all), not a registered-projects designDecision (re-read this run: the 4 designDecisions cover discount rate, token pause, normalized rates, and minter deposits — none mention nudge, streamer, or claim liveness), not a README/known-issues.md item, and not a bot-race entry.

(2) NOT TRACEABLE TO ANY STORY ARTEFACT. story-faithfulness read all five [story-026] commit bodies in full (3e1259b, e7f8a45, 2dc2426, b14522d, f704130) and found the design facts recorded but NO acceptance decision and no pre-adjudication as a non-finding. I independently confirmed the commit set (git log: exactly those five [story-026] commits above 0fef726) and confirmed CLAUDE.md is silent on the rail.

(3) SELF-REFERENTIAL DISQUALIFICATION. DEDUP-003 exists PRECISELY to object to this sentence. Suppressing DEDUP-003 on the strength of the sentence DEDUP-003 indicts would let the artefact under audit adjudicate the finding against itself — the exact circularity the finding names. That is unconditionally impermissible.

(4) SCOPE MISMATCH even on its own terms. The acceptance, taken at face value, is scoped to the triggers the document itself enumerates (post-deploy unset :72-74; setNudgeAddress repoint :78-79). It cannot immunize setRewardToken (DEDUP-001), which the document omits — an owner cannot have accepted a consequence they were never told about.

(5) LAW 1. Suppressing an availability brick on SYA's ONLY permissionless entry point — machine-verified this run with revert selector 0xd62cbfe8 and a direct storage assertion — on the authority of a comment inside the file under audit would be a Law-1 violation. Recall beats report-tidiness.
selfSuppressingClaimRuling.whatWouldChangeThis: A human triage decision recorded via /ledger (status acknowledged or wont-fix on the minted fingerprint), or a designDecision added to registered-projects.json. Either would be legitimate authority in a FUTURE run. Neither exists now. Note the Law-1 caution: even then, an 'acknowledged' disposal must not be applied to a finding the owner intends to FIX — that is fix-pending, which is never suppressed.
